action_summary: Reuse the existing Git operation grammar, prose/value boundary, typed contract admission and role-aware intent matcher. Reach short repository read requests without adding providers; constrain ordinary operations to operation-bearing contracts; refuse ambiguous stated Git plans before lexical execution; preserve caller lookup for a function named rename and source-edit obligations after function-role words.
explicit_user_authorization: Do the optimal in the fastest way. Everything must be insanely fast, only the right way. and merge all of your work
causal_blocker: Short Git reads did not enter the authoritative family, bindable bisectors competed with authorship operations, operation words inside values contaminated derivation, and upstream broad name checks rejected caller queries or hid real source-edit obligations.
falsification_condition: A short read fails to execute the real Git adapter, a value supplies operation or commit authority, an ambiguous operation reaches primary execution, a bindable bisector competes with ordinary operation input contracts, or the existing caller/source-obligation regressions recur.
remaining_limits: Authorship operation selection does not add missing target or line-range transport to the public contract.
An existing derivation test file contains JSON rather than executable Python and fails collection.
No claim of complete repository correctness, universal speed optimality or general software-engineering qualification.
